question.text: A body of mass $5 \mathrm{~kg}$ under the action of constant force $\vec{F}=F_x \hat{i}+F_y \hat{j}$ has velocity at $\mathrm{t}=0 \mathrm{~s}$ as $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{v}}=(6 \hat{\mathrm{i}}-2 \hat{\mathrm{j}} \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s})$ and at $\mathrm{t}=10 \mathrm{~s}$ as $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{v}}=+6 \hat{\mathrm{j}} \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}$. The force $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{F}}$ is:

solution.text:
From question,
Mass of body, $m=5 \mathrm{~kg}$
Velocity at $t=0$,
$$
u=(6 \hat{i}-2 \hat{j}) \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}
$$
Velocity at $t=10 \mathrm{~s}$,
$$
v=+6 \hat{j} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}
$$
Force, $F=$ ?
Acceleration, $a=\frac{v-u}{t}$
$$
=\frac{6 \hat{j}-(6 \hat{i}-2 \hat{j})}{10}=\frac{-3 \hat{i}+4 \hat{j}}{5} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2
$$
Force, $F=m a$
$$
=5 \times \frac{(-3 \hat{i}+4 \hat{j})}{5}=(-3 \hat{i}+4 \hat{j}) N
$$
